description: Produce a diagnostic report of stale daemons: write_service (3h23m), mcp_scanner (4h31m), rug_pull_monitor (602h4m), anti_entropy (4h35m), wisdom_synthesiser (4h35m). Query service_health table to confirm last_heartbeat timestamps. Identify which are dead vs merely slow. For rug_pull_monitor (602h), check if PID file exists and process is running. Output JSON report with daemon_name, status, age_seconds, likely_cause, recommended_action (restart vs investigate). This is diagnostic only — do NOT restart daemons. Spec reference: Section 6 heartbeat contract, Section 10 execution rules (diagnostic preferred over rebuild for protected files).
